description: Answers the market question you ask, not a fixed one. Give it a question about Bitcoin, Ethereum, altcoins or macro — "is funding overheated", "does macro support a long here", "which of these three is most crowded" — and it selects the live data tools it needs (prices, funding rates, open interest, Fear & Greed, macro rates), runs them, and returns one JSON object: regime, confidence, the numbers behind the call, bull and bear scenarios, and the level that invalidates the thesis. Calling it WITHOUT payment costs nothing and returns a sample of exactly that output, so the quality can be judged before any money moves. For a fixed report on one coin instead, get_market_brief in this same server is free. Settlement is $0.25 in USDC on Base over x402, per call — no signup, no key, no account.

context.description: Optional free-form context to take into account.

language.description: Language of the text fields. Defaults to en.

question.description: The question to answer, e.g. "Is BTC funding overheated right now?"

name: analyze_market

invalidation_level.description: Price level that invalidates the call.

key_data.description: The concrete numbers behind the call, metric name to value.
